forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
During week 33, teams completed 1 zone survey, 1 visit and 2 clearances. NAR-Z02 was declared free, bringing the total to 8 zones; 24 areas have been released and 11 cleared. There were 4 survey and 4 clearance teams active.

For the officer’s attention: the access feed shows 10 zones closed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held, and no new plan was approved; work remains under P08.

The week 32 forecast applies to the zones of the plan it was made with, counting what is done already. Its P10 to P90 range is 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 11 zones declared free this season.
